instruction.text: Emma is playing at her first concert today. Select the clapping hands to applaud her.

feedback.end: Do you recognise the instrument Emma is playing? These are a special type of drum called timpani.

hint.text: You can recognise the drumheads by the light blue areas that are highlighted in the picture.
hint.label: Drumheads

atoms.text: Select one of the drumheads of the timpani to hear how they sound.

instruction.text: Emma left her mallets under a chair on stage. Can you find them?

feedback.end: Special drumsticks called mallets are used to hit timpani.

instruction.text: How do you play the timpani?

hint.label: Mallets
hint.text: The two drumsticks needed for the timpani are called mallets.

b.sound: You hit the drumheads of the timpani with mallets.
You knock on the side of the timpani with your hands.

instruction.text: What do you use to strike the drumheads of the timpani with? Select the correct answer.

wrong.sound: This is a bo. It’s used to play string instruments like the violin.

feedback.correct: The timpani are struck with mallets.
